svg.aria-label: Samet İçim — Tell me about your idea, we'll make it happen.
svg.title: Samet İçim — Tell me about your idea, we'll make it happen.

g.text: We don’t box ourselves into one category. Software and games are our core;
alongside them we do 3D printing, hardware. If your need isn’t on the list we
still don’t say no — we find the right people and manage the work ourselves.
